name: MA2CCI
summary: This EA combines two Moving Averages with the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) to generate trading signals. It enters long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and CCI confirms momentum, and enters short positions on the opposite conditions. The strategy is a trend-momentum hybrid that uses MA for direction and CCI for momentum confirmation.
summary_zh: 该EA结合两条移动平均线和商品通道指标(CCI)来生成交易信号。当快线上穿慢线且CCI确认动量时做多，反之作空。该策略是趋势-动量混合型，用MA判断方向，用CCI确认动量。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是双重确认：移动平均线交叉提供趋势方向信号，CCI指标提供动量确认。入场条件为快线上穿慢线且CCI高于指定阈值时做多，快线下穿慢线且CCI低于负阈值时做空。出场条件通常依赖于反向交叉信号或固定的止损止盈水平。仓位管理方面，该EA使用固定手数交易，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为简单，缺乏基于账户余额或风险百分比的动态计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺少过滤机制来避免震荡行情中的频繁假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is dual confirmation: Moving Average crossover provides trend direction signals while CCI provides momentum confirmation. Entry conditions are long when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and CCI is above a specified threshold, and short on the opposite conditions. Exit conditions typically rely on reverse crossover signals or fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses fixed lots without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management is relatively simple, lacking dynamic calculation based on account balance or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear but lacks filtering mechanisms to avoid frequent false signals in ranging markets.
pros: 双重确认机制减少假信号，MA和CCI互补验证提高信号可靠性
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调整参数
CCI动量确认能有效过滤弱势趋势中的入场信号
pros_en: Dual confirmation mechanism reduces false signals; MA and CCI complement each other to improve signal reliability
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and adjust parameters
CCI momentum confirmation effectively filters out entry signals in weak trends
cons: 固定手数交易缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整风险敞口
在震荡行情中MA交叉频繁产生假信号，即使有CCI过滤仍可能过度交易
缺少新K线检查机制，可能同一根K线内多次开仓导致重复入场
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
MA crossovers generate frequent false signals in ranging markets; even with CCI filtering, overtrading may still occur
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar causing duplicate entries
improvements: 添加ATR动态止损和仓位管理，根据市场波动自动调整风险参数
增加新K线检查和持仓检查机制，避免重复开仓和过度交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add new bar check and position check mechanisms to avoid duplicate entries and overtrading

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
固定手数和固定止损未考虑市场波动性变化
震荡行情中MA交叉频繁可能产生连续亏损信号
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions within the same bar
Fixed lots and fixed stop-loss do not account for changes in market volatility
Frequent MA crossovers in ranging markets may produce consecutive losing signals

The strategy is a trend-momentum hybrid that uses MA for direction and CCI for momentum confirmation.
